title: Everyday Phrases — Playing Tennis
title_quote: Do you want to play tennis?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🎾 實用打網球必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Playing Tennis
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用打網球情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從約時間訂場地、熱身發球對拉，到計分換邊與賽後拉伸，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Playing Tennis phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), from booking a court and warming up, to serving, scoring, changeovers and post-match stretching. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want to play tennis?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! I miss playing with you.
dialogue.zh: 想啊！我好懷念跟你一起打球。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you free on Saturday morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning is fine. Let's play early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine o'clock sounds good to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can we start at eight thirty?
dialogue.zh: 我們能八點三十分開始嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight thirty is a little early.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, nine works for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we meet that day?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Meet me at the south gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The courts near the big park?
dialogue.zh: 是大公園旁邊那些球場嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the ones with green fences.
dialogue.zh: 對，就是綠色圍欄那幾個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will call and book a court.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kɔl ənd bʊk ə kɔrt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do it today, weekends fill fast.
dialogue.zh: 今天就訂，假日一下子就滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they rent courts by the hour?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ rɛnt kɔrts baɪ ði ˈaʊər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one hour costs twenty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's book two hours together.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is forty dollars in total.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay now by phone?
dialogue.zh: 我現在能用電話付錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or pay when we get there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which court is free at nine?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Court three should be open then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that court outside or inside?
dialogue.zh: 那個場地在室外還是室內？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is outside, with good lights.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ground there is hard cement.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like cement, the ball runs fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk səˈmɛnt, ðə bɔl rʌnz fæst./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡水泥地，球跑得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I bring my own balls?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring three, a tube costs money.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My racket strings broke yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You need new strings right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I get a racket strung?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈrækət strʌŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop near the train station.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does stringing usually take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two days, sometimes three in busy weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz, ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz θri ɪn ˈbɪzi wikz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for the stringing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen dollars, plus the string fee.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you lend me a racket?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, take the blue one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that one heavy or light?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels light in your hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What grip size should I choose?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the middle size first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one feels great, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just bring it back next week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have spare tennis socks?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have two thick pairs for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv tu θɪk pɛrz fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 我有兩雙厚的可以給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tennis socks stop my blisters.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine slide down when I run.
dialogue.zh: 我的襪子跑步時老往下滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wear tennis shoes, not running shoes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why? Are they different on courts?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？在場地上不一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tennis shoes grip when you move sideways.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɛnɪs ʃuz ɡrɪp wɛn ju muv ˈsaɪdˌweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 網球鞋在你橫向移動時抓得住地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good point, I will change mine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring a big bottle of water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will fill my bottle tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我今天晚上先把瓶子裝滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two bottles, it gets very hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And some towels for our faces.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a cap or hat?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə kæp ɔr hæt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the sun hurts my eyes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put sunscreen on your nose.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I forgot that, I will buy one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fərˈɡɑt ðæt, aɪ wɪl baɪ wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The weather says thirty-five degrees.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is too hot for morning tennis.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz tu hɑt fər ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈtɛnɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we move to a later time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi muv tu ə ˈleɪtər taɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, evening courts are cooler.
dialogue.zh: 好，傍晚的球場涼快多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is six in the evening okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six is perfect for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will change our booking now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在去改我們的預約。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask if the lights cost extra.
dialogue.zh: 問一下開燈要不要加錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Night play needs strong lights.
dialogue.zh: 晚上打球需要很亮的燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Court three has the best ones.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the courts close at ten?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They close at eleven in summer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it rain that evening?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rain, only a light wind.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wind can push the ball away.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we serve slower and lower.
dialogue.zh: 那我們發球就慢一點低一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I bring my little brother?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He can watch from the seats.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He wants to learn tennis too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can hit balls after our match.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn hɪt bɔlz ˈæftər ˈaʊər mætʃ./
dialogue.zh: 比完賽我們可以陪他練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring snacks as well?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bananas help with energy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will pack two bananas and nuts.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pæk tu bəˈnænz ənd nʌts./
dialogue.zh: 我帶兩根香蕉和一些堅果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one cold drink for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you stretch before last time?
dialogue.zh: 你上次打球前有拉筋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, and my arm hurt for days.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ənd maɪ ɑrm hɜrt fər deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我手臂痛了好幾天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm up your shoulders first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will do ten arm circles.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call me if plans change again.
dialogue.zh: 計畫再變，就打電話給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will text you before six.
dialogue.zh: 六點之前我會傳訊息給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am really excited now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will be a fun match.
dialogue.zh: 那一定會是有趣的一場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you at the court gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the racket you borrowed.
dialogue.zh: 把你借的那支球拍帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, can I use my own racket?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, kæn aɪ juz maɪ ˈoʊn ˈrækət?/
dialogue.zh: 等等，我可以用我自己那支嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is still at the stringer.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt ɪz stɪl æt ðə ˈstrɪŋər./
dialogue.zh: 不行，你那支還在穿線店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will bring the blue one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ðə blu wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we meet right at six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, see you on the court.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Play your best that day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! You made it right on time.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ! ju meɪd ɪt raɪt ɑn taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The court is open, look over there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɔrt ɪz ˈoʊpən, lʊk ˈoʊvər ðɛr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's put our bags by the fence.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts pʊt ˈaʊər bæɡz baɪ ðə fɛns./
dialogue.zh: 我們把球包放在圍欄邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should we change shoes first?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, these shoes feel slippery.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The surface looks dry to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's warm up with some light hits.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts wɔrm ʌp wɪð sʌm laɪt hɪts./
dialogue.zh: 我們先輕輕打幾下熱身。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand on the baseline, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hit soft balls to my side.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will aim for your forehand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, that rally felt nice.
dialogue.zh: 不錯，那幾拍對拉很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you want to keep rallying?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little more, then we serve.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your arm looks looser now.
dialogue.zh: 你的手臂現在看起來放鬆多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How should I hold this racket?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shake hands with it, like this.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like shaking a friend's hand?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is the basic grip.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my grip be tight or loose?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd maɪ ɡrɪp bi taɪt ɔr lus?/
dialogue.zh: 握拍要緊一點還是松一點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it soft, squeeze at contact.
dialogue.zh: 平時放鬆，碰到球才收緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My knuckles hurt when I swing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You grip too hard, relax them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way should the face point?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it square to the net.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I turn my body first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, turn your shoulder sideways.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now show me your ready stance.
dialogue.zh: 現在做個準備姿勢給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this, knees bent, light feet.
dialogue.zh: 這樣，膝蓋彎著，腳步放輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bounce the ball before you serve.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It helps me find my rhythm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand behind the line, not on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd bɪˈhaɪnd ðə laɪn, nɑt ɑn ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is this far back behind the line?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs fɑr bæk bɪˈhaɪnd ðə laɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 這樣站在線後面夠遠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Point your racket at the target.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which side should I serve to?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Serve across the court, diagonally.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Into the small box, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that is the service box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If it hits the net, I replay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ɪt hɪts ðə nɛt, aɪ riˈpleɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 如果撞到網，我要重發嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a let, try again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, so I lost no point.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How high should I toss the ball?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ haɪ ʃʊd aɪ tɔs ðə bɔl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bit higher than your reach.
dialogue.zh: 比你的可及高度再高一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About one arm above my head?
dialogue.zh: 大約高過我的頭一隻手臂？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, hit it at the top point.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hɪt ɪt æt ðə tɑp pɔɪnt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My toss keeps falling behind me.
dialogue.zh: 我拋的球老是落到我身後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Toss it a little out front.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bend my knees when tossing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ bɛnd maɪ niz wɛn ˈtɔsɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 拋球的時候膝蓋要彎嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bend them and push up strong.
dialogue.zh: 彎一下，然後用力蹬上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swing up, not across your body.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like reaching for a high shelf?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, snap your wrist at contact.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，擊球瞬間手腕抖一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My serve sounded better just now.
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛那球發球聽起來比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Serve slow first, aim deep.
dialogue.zh: 發球先慢一點，打深一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deep means near the back line?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, deep balls are harder to attack.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, dip bɔlz ɑr ˈhɑrdər tu əˈtæk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will try a soft deep serve.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl traɪ ə sɔft dip sɜrv./
dialogue.zh: 我來試一個輕一點的深發球。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice! That one landed safely in.
dialogue.zh: 漂亮！那顆球穩穩進區了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more serves, then my turn.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your forehand cross is strong.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I swing it with my whole arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ swɪŋ ɪt wɪð maɪ hoʊl ɑrm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use your shoulder turn, not just your arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz jʊr ˈʃoʊldər tɜrn, nɑt dʒʌst jʊr ɑrm./
dialogue.zh: 要靠轉肩出力，不只是揮手臂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So my body does the work?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Follow through over the other shoulder.
dialogue.zh: 收拍揮到另一邊的肩膀上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My balls flew high when I did that.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bɔlz flu haɪ wɛn aɪ dɪd ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 我那樣做完球都飛得好高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drop the racket head a bit lower.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɑp ðə ˈrækət hɛd ə bɪt ˈloʊər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then brush up to make spin?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, spin keeps the ball inside.
dialogue.zh: 對，旋轉能讓球留在界內。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Topspin feels odd on my strings.
dialogue.zh: 上旋在我拍線上感覺怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's practice your backhand now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hand or two hands?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hands give you more control.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My left hand feels weak there.
dialogue.zh: 我左手在那邊使不上力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep your elbows close to you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I turn and step into the ball.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tɜrn ənd stɛp ˈɪntu ðə bɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我轉身然後踏步進去打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great! That backhand went deep.
dialogue.zh: 太好了！那記反手打得很深。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw it land near the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ɪt lænd nɪr ðə laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我看到它落在界線附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Low balls are my biggest problem.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bend your knees and get under it.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛnd jʊr niz ənd ɡɛt ˈʌndər ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 屈膝，把拍子插到球下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I watch the ball or you?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ wɑtʃ ðə bɔl ɔr ju?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch the ball until it hits strings.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə bɔl ənˈtɪl ɪt hɪts strɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 盯球一直盯到撞上拍線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is hard to do every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz hɑrd tu du ˈɛvri taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 那真的很難每次都做到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count the bounce out loud, it helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ðə baʊns aʊt laʊd, ɪt hɛlps./
dialogue.zh: 把彈地的聲音大聲數出來，會更容易專注。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet keep stopping too soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small steps keep you balanced.
dialogue.zh: 小碎步能讓你保持平衡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who will gather our three balls?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just put them in your bag first.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst pʊt ðɛm ɪn jʊr bæɡ fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 先把它們放回你的球包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can hold two under my arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn hoʊld tu ˈʌndər maɪ ɑrm./
dialogue.zh: 我手臂下可以夾兩顆球。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not drop them near the net.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt drɑp ðɛm nɪr ðə nɛt./
dialogue.zh: 別在球網附近讓它們掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A yellow ball rolled under the fence.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈjɛloʊ bɔl roʊld ˈʌndər ðə fɛns./
dialogue.zh: 有一顆黃球滾到圍欄底下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it, that one is not ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt, ðæt wʌn ɪz nɑt ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 別管了，那顆不是我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A ball on the court is dangerous.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɔl ɑn ðə kɔrt ɪz ˈdeɪnʤərəs./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You could step on it and fall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kʊd stɛp ɑn ɪt ənd fɔl./
dialogue.zh: 你可能踩到它然後摔倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's gather them after this game.
dialogue.zh: 這一局打完我們再收球。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will use my shirt pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are sweaty from the grip.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hænz ɑr ˈswɛti frʌm ðə ɡrɪp./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe them on your shorts, then play.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðɛm ɑn jʊr ʃɔrts, ðɛn pleɪ./
dialogue.zh: 在短褲上擦擦，然後繼續打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you ready for a real point?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈrɛdi fər ə ril pɔɪnt?/
dialogue.zh: 你準備好認真打一分了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, serve to my backhand please.
dialogue.zh: 好了，請發到我反手這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here I come, watch this serve.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am ready, hit it hard.
dialogue.zh: 我準備好了，儘管用力發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's keep score this time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tennis numbers sound so strange.
dialogue.zh: 網球的分數聽起來好奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The first point is called fifteen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the next point is thirty?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, then forty for the third.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why is there no forty-five?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody knows, it is tradition.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So forty means almost one game.
dialogue.zh: 所以四十就快贏一局了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more point wins the game.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What if we are both at forty?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf wi ɑr boʊθ æt ˈfɔrti?/
dialogue.zh: 如果兩邊都是四十分呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is deuce, lead by two.
dialogue.zh: 那是平分，你要領先兩分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So one point is not enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You need advantage, then one more.
dialogue.zh: 你先佔優勢，然後再拿一分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Advantage means I lead by one.
dialogue.zh: 佔先就是說我領先一分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If you lose it, back to deuce.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ju luz ɪt, bæk tu dus./
dialogue.zh: 如果你又輸掉，就回到平分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deuce feels endless in long games.
dialogue.zh: 打很久的時候平分好像沒完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I serve first, you receive next.
dialogue.zh: 我先發球，下一個換你接。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We switch servers every game.
dialogue.zh: 每一局我們都交換髮球。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call the score before each serve.
dialogue.zh: 每次發球前先把分數報出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My number first or yours?
dialogue.zh: 先報我的還是先報你的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The server always speaks first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen-love, so I am behind.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Love simply means zero here.
dialogue.zh: 那個詞在這裡就是零分的意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That word is fun to say.
dialogue.zh: 那個字講起來挺有趣的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You serve now, say it first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty-love, so I am ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six games win the whole set.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And what happens at five all?
dialogue.zh: 那五比五的時候怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You must win by two games.
dialogue.zh: 你得領先兩局才算拿下一盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And when it gets to six all?
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd wɛn ɪt ɡɛts tu sɪks ɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 那打到六比六的時候呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then you play a tiebreak game.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So no fifteen or forty there?
dialogue.zh: 那邊就沒有十五或四十嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, first to seven wins it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I double faulted twice in a row.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈdʌbəl ˈfɔltəd twaɪs ɪn ə roʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A double fault gives the point away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈdʌbəl fɔlt ɡɪvz ðə pɔɪnt əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 雙誤的話，這一分就直接白送了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My second serve felt too careful.
dialogue.zh: 我的第二發球太小心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try it slower with more spin.
dialogue.zh: 試慢一點，多加一些旋轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two serves for every point, right?
dialogue.zh: 每一分有兩次發球，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Miss both and the point is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪs boʊθ ənd ðə pɔɪnt ɪz ɡɔn./
dialogue.zh: 兩次都失誤，這分就沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hit the net on my first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪt ðə nɛt ɑn maɪ fɜrst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that a fault or a let?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðæt ə fɔlt ɔr ə lɛt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It landed out, so it was a fault.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈlændɪd aʊt, soʊ ɪt wʌz ə fɔlt./
dialogue.zh: 球落到界外，所以是失誤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take a breath and trust your toss.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ə brɛθ ənd trʌst jʊr tɔs./
dialogue.zh: 深呼吸，相信你拋起來的球。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Was that ball in or out?
dialogue.zh: 剛才那顆球算進還是算出？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saw it clearly outside the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ɪt ˈklɪrli ˈaʊtˌsaɪd ðə laɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine touched the line, so it is good.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tʊtʃt ðə laɪn, soʊ ɪt ɪz ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 我的壓到線了，所以算好球。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True, any line counts as in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think your ball went wide.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得你的球飛太開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looked good from my side.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe. Let us replay that point.
dialogue.zh: 也許吧，那一分我們重打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are kind, I agree.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In matches we ask for a challenge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ˈmætʃəz wi æsk fər ə ˈtʃæləndʒ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No camera here, only our eyes.
dialogue.zh: 這裡沒有攝影機，只有我們的眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we play honest, no arguing.
dialogue.zh: 所以我們要誠實打，不爭吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bad call is no big deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bæd kɔl ɪz noʊ bɪɡ dil./
dialogue.zh: 看錯一分不是什麼大事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is our changeover now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We switch sides after odd games.
dialogue.zh: 單數局之後我們交換場地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down and dry your face.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My towel is inside my bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drink water, not just a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am thirsty, pass the bottle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, sip it slow, do not gulp.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, sɪp ɪt sloʊ, du nɑt ɡʌlp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We get ninety seconds for this break.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɡɛt ˈnaɪnti ˈsɛkəndz fər ðɪs breɪk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest your legs, feet down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweat keeps running into my eyes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear your headband, it helps a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr jʊr ˈhɛdˌbænd, ɪt hɛlps ə lɑt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands shake a bit from the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hænz ʃeɪk ə bɪt frʌm ðə hit./
dialogue.zh: 我的手因為太熱有點發抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand in the shade one minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the coach is walking over.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hello coach, my footwork feels wrong.
dialogue.zh: 教練好，我的步伐感覺不對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stay on your toes, not flat.
dialogue.zh: 腳掌前緣踩地，別整腳平壓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like small hops before I run?
dialogue.zh: 像起跑前先小小跳一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Split step when your rival hits.
dialogue.zh: 對手擊球當下做分腿墊步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I always stand still and watch.
dialogue.zh: 我卻總是站著不動看球。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Return to the middle after each shot.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈtɜrn tu ðə ˈmɪdəl ˈæftər iʧ ʃɑt./
dialogue.zh: 每一拍之後回到場中央。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is why I am always late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪs waɪ aɪ æm ˈɔlˌweɪz leɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small steps, then one long push.
dialogue.zh: 先小碎步，再跨出一大步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I run from side to side?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ rʌn frʌm saɪd tu saɪd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slide into the ball on hard courts.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪd ˈɪntu ðə bɔl ɑn hɑrd kɔrts./
dialogue.zh: 在硬地上要滑步進去擊球。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My shoes squeak so loudly there.
dialogue.zh: 我球鞋在那裡吱吱響很大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn early, take the racket back.
dialogue.zh: 早點轉體，把拍子往後帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wait too long every time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch my feet and copy the pattern.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ maɪ fit ənd ˈkɑpi ðə ˈpætərn./
dialogue.zh: 看我的腳步，照著這個模式做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Again, a little slower, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better! You reached that wide ball.
dialogue.zh: 好多了！那顆外角球你夠到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The steps really made a difference.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not lean back when you hit.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt lin bæk wɛn ju hɪt./
dialogue.zh: 擊球的時候身體別往後仰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My balls fly long when I lean.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bɔlz flai lɔŋ wɛn aɪ lin./
dialogue.zh: 我一仰身體球就打超界。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep your eyes on the incoming ball.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip jʊr aɪz ɑn ðə ɪnˈkʌmɪŋ bɔl./
dialogue.zh: 眼睛要盯著飛過來的球。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, coach! I will count the bounce.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks, koʊtʃ! aɪ wɪl kaʊnt ðə baʊns./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝教練！我會大聲數彈地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much time is left?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more game, then we stop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Score is five games to three.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are serving for the set.
dialogue.zh: 你在發可以拿下這盤的一局。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stay calm, one point at a time.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ kɑm, wʌn pɔɪnt æt ə taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clapping helps me stay awake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The crowd here is just birds.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的觀眾只有幾隻鳥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then clap louder for yourself.
dialogue.zh: 那就替自己更大聲拍手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready? I will serve to the corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi? aɪ wɪl sɜrv tu ðə ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 準備好了嗎？我要發到角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Serve it, I will be waiting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is the last game now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The winner takes the whole match?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, one point decides the set.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My hands are sweating again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have two set points now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will save both of them, watch me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl seɪv boʊθ əv ðɛm, wɑtʃ mi./
dialogue.zh: 這兩分我都會救回來，看著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will serve wide, be ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am watching your racket face.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great return! That was fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky, I only moved one foot.
dialogue.zh: 運氣啦，我只是動了一隻腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deuce again, this feels tense.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe out before you serve.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Game and set, that is it!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you earned it point by point.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ju ɜrnd ɪt pɔɪnt baɪ pɔɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，那盤是你一分一分拚下來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good game, you played well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are too kind, you were better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr tu kaɪnd, ju wɜr ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 你太客氣了，你打得更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us shake hands at the net.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ʃeɪk hændz æt ðə nɛt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, a firm handshake for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That long rally was the best.
dialogue.zh: 那一串多拍對拉最精彩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I ran for eleven shots there.
dialogue.zh: 那一球我來回跑了十一拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I won, though my serve kept failing.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʌn, ðoʊ maɪ sɜrv kɛpt ˈfeɪlɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我贏是贏了，不過發球一直出問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My footwork is the real problem.
dialogue.zh: 我的步伐才是真正的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You gave the match a real try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡeɪv ðə mætʃ ə ril traɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I enjoyed every point.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's pack the balls away.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count them, we started with three.
dialogue.zh: 數一下，我們一開始是三顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two are here, one is missing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check under the bench, I see it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ˈʌndər ðə bɛntʃ, aɪ si ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 看看板凳底下，我看到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let me return your racket.
dialogue.zh: 現在把你的球拍還給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did it feel good to play?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The handle fit my hand perfectly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it tonight, practice at home.
dialogue.zh: 今晚先留著，在家裡空揮練習。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the strings still okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little loose, but they are fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl lus, bʌt ðeɪ ɑr faɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will wipe it before I return it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl waɪp ɪt bɪˈfɔr aɪ rɪˈtɜrn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我歸還之前會先擦乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush, bring it next Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 不著急，下週天帶來就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was my headband useful today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very, my eyes thank you too.
dialogue.zh: 很有用，我的眼睛也謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My leg feels tight after running.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stretch it now, do not sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /strɛtʃ ɪt naʊ, du nɑt sɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 現在拉一下，別坐著不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which muscle hurts the most?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The back of my thigh, right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk əv maɪ θaɪ, raɪt hɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold that stretch for thirty seconds.
dialogue.zh: 那個拉筋動作停三十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I feel pain while holding?
dialogue.zh: 停留的時候應該會痛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only a gentle pull, never sharp pain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ə ˈdʒɛntəl pʊl, ˈnɛvər ʃɑrp peɪn./
dialogue.zh: 只有輕輕的拉扯感，不可以刺痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will breathe while stretching.
dialogue.zh: 好，拉筋的時候我會呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoulders are stiff from serving.
dialogue.zh: 我肩膀因為發球好僵硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cross your arm and press it in.
dialogue.phonetic: /krɔs jʊr ɑrm ənd prɛs ɪt ɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps, do the other side.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your turn now, lean toward me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My calf is cramping a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flex your toes up toward your knee.
dialogue.phonetic: /flɛks jʊr toʊz ʌp təˈwɔrd jʊr ni./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Much better, thank you for that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ice your calf when you get home.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs jʊr kæf wɛn ju ɡɛt hoʊm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you hungry after all that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Starving. Let's get some food.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The café beside the court is open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kæˈfeɪ bɪˈsaɪd ðə kɔrt ɪz ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 球場旁邊那家咖啡廳還開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I want a sandwich and juice.
dialogue.zh: 我要一份三明治和果汁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bananas were a smart idea today.
dialogue.zh: 今天帶香蕉真是好主意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It really helped me in game six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈrɪli hɛlpt mi ɪn ɡeɪm sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 第六局的時候真的幫到我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want the salty snacks?
dialogue.zh: 你想吃鹹的那種點心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nuts and some dried fruit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cookie is still warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save me half of that, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea or water after exercise?
dialogue.zh: 運動完要喝茶還是喝水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water first, then a cold tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need to wash my hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sink is by the entrance door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɪŋk ɪz baɪ ði ˈɛntrəns dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shirt is wet through completely.
dialogue.zh: 我的球衣整個都濕透了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the spare one in my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə spɛr wʌn ɪn maɪ bæɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You planned all this so well.
dialogue.zh: 你把這一切都安排得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I only brought socks and towels.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How will you feel tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sore everywhere, but a good sore.
dialogue.zh: 全身痠痛，不過是好的痠痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walk slowly, skip the stairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My knees will decide that for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ niz wɪl dɪˈsaɪd ðæt fər mi./
dialogue.zh: 我的膝蓋會替我做決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we play again next week?
dialogue.zh: 我們下週再打一場好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, same court, same evening time.
dialogue.zh: 好，同樣的場地同樣的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Book two hours, not just one.
dialogue.zh: 訂兩小時，不要只訂一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am on it right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time let's invite two more.
dialogue.zh: 下次我們再多邀兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we can play doubles there.
dialogue.zh: 那樣我們就能在那裡打雙打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I should take a real lesson soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ʃʊd teɪk ə ril ˈlɛsən sun./
dialogue.zh: 我該快點去上一堂正課。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, the coach today was great.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du, ðə koʊtʃ təˈdeɪ wʌz ɡreɪt./
dialogue.zh: 去吧，今天那位教練真的很會教。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you take any photos today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, you look serious in one.
dialogue.zh: 兩張，其中一張你看起來很認真。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send them to me tonight, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will add them to our group.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl æd ðɛm tu ˈaʊər ɡrup./
dialogue.zh: 我會把它們放到我們群組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want to buy new balls?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt tu baɪ nu bɔlz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours still bounce well enough.
dialogue.zh: 我們這些球彈得還夠好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then next time bring your own.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, I will leave them in my car.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil, aɪ wɪl liv ðɛm ɪn maɪ kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 好，我把它們放在我車上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you driving home right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, do you want a ride?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only if the road is not long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ðə roʊd ɪz nɑt lɔŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, then I drop you off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts, ðɛn aɪ drɑp ju ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘，然後我送你到家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today was worth the whole week.
dialogue.zh: 今天值得我等了一整個禮拜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's never miss another Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 我們別再錯過任何一個星期六。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, rest those tired legs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you next week on court.
